coordinates: right-handed Z-up: x right, y away, z up
note: PLACEHOLDER geometry: realistic estimates, not measured (measured:false throughout). Box sizes come from config/rig.json parcels. The GLBs in assets/models were baked at older sizes; viewer/model-fit.mjs scales their parts at load time to the sizes below. Blender has not been rerun.

sweeper.name: Cylindrical Sweeper
sweeper.note: Every value is an UNMEASURED PLACEHOLDER. Sweeper frame: origin on the bench top directly under the can's centre, x right, y away from the front, z up. The can lies on its side with its axis along y; its open/top end faces the boxes (-y).

can._note: Empty slim aluminium drinks can, 53 mm in diameter and 100 mm long. The 0.6 mm rolled rims set its centre height; +y is the closed end.

assemblyTilt._note: The front rim acts as the tilt pivot. The upper stop keeps the wooden tip above the platform throughout its full turn.

servo._note: 9 g micro servo on a 6.4 mm riser, shaft 2 mm above the case. The 3 mm horn holds the stick above it. The shaft is vertical at zero tilt.

stick._note: 145 × 10 × 3 mm hardwood craft strip with the pivot 5 mm from the mounting end. The 2 g mass corresponds to approximately 460 kg/m³.

workbench.note: The parcel stays at the pick centre. The fixed sweeper sits behind it, 85 mm from the back face of the parcel to the front rim of the can.
